doc.summary: A registry provider is the analogue of a <ref cls="net/minecraft/data/DataProvider">DataProvider</ref> for the <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/datagen/DatagenStage" field="REGISTRY_SETUP">registry setup</ref>  and <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/datagen/DatagenStage" field="EXTENSION_SETUP">extension setup</ref> stages.
doc.text: A registry provider is the analogue of a <ref cls="net/minecraft/data/DataProvider">DataProvider</ref> for the <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/datagen/DatagenStage" field="REGISTRY_SETUP">registry setup</ref>  and <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/datagen/DatagenStage" field="EXTENSION_SETUP">extension setup</ref> stages. It can register elements to the relevant registries  which will be written to the datagen output once the datagen finishes.
